feature_layers.event_scalar: 18 class-agnostic event targets + 18 independent quality values + 4 modality-presence values
feature_layers.event_sequence: 32 steps x (16 Skeleton relation/delta + 25 IMU invariants + 10 visual motion/context scalars)
feature_layers.raw_token: 32 steps x all 43 Skeleton + 60 IMU + 106 Depth/IR token channels

selection_boundary: All models fit and evaluate only the three fixed subject-disjoint splits inside fold-0 outer-train. No fold-0 outer-held prediction is generated.
probe_success_signal: A sequential layer must add held-subject Hard information over base-only in at least two folds and lose relevant performance under content/order ablations; a single best fold is insufficient.
